summary: Incorrect intercompany ledger routing in entity_map_v3 causing AP payment batch to skip vendor invoices
description: During the nightly AP payment run (ap_payment_runner_03) a subset of vendor invoices were skipped because the normalized entity mapping assigned them to a legal entity without an associated bank account for the selected payment method. The change correlates with a recent deployment of finance-data normalization (entity_map_v3) that updated mapping logic for external tax IDs.
impact: 19 vendor invoices (totaling $142,380.20) were not included in the scheduled vendor ACH run. Affected vendors include Nordic Supplies AB and two regional contractors. Payments are currently on hold; this may trigger late fees and vendor escalations if not resolved before the next payroll window.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Run ap_payment_runner_03 in prod with parameter --window=2026-03-09
2) Observe the job report: invoices flagged as 'legal_entity_mismatch' and skipped
3) Inspect normalized mapping for vendor external_tax_id starting with 'SE' — mapping points to LEG_EU_02 instead of LEG_GLOBAL
4) Confirm LEG_EU_02 has no bank account configured for ACH method in bank_account table
logs: 2026-03-10T02:14:22Z ap_payment_runner_03 ERROR invoice INV-2026-33421 skipped: legal_entity_mismatch: bank_account_not_assigned
2026-03-10T02:14:22Z ap_payment_runner_03 INFO invoice INV-2026-33431 skipped: legal_entity_mismatch
2026-03-10T02:14:23Z entity-normalizer INFO applying entity_map_v3 to tax_id 'SE556677-XX' -> LEG_EU_02 (confidence=0.92)
2026-03-10T02:14:24Z payments-validator WARN legal entity LEG_EU_02 missing bank account for method ACH
investigation_notes: Initial triage by Finance Ops (Maya): confirmed skipped invoices and total exposure.
Data team (Raj) reproduced in staging by running entity_map_v3; mapping behavior matches prod output.

Hypothesis: entity_map_v3 introduced a precedence change where country-coded tax_id prefixes map to regional entity before checking vendor-level override. Previously vendor-level override pointed to LEG_GLOBAL.
Temporary workaround tested: manual override of invoice.legal_entity to LEG_GLOBAL allows ap_payment_runner_03 to include invoice in subset run.
No evidence this is related to the bank vault or KMS; purely mapping/normalization logic.
Related config: finance-data repo commit 9f3b2a7 updated entity_map_v3 on 2026-03-09 (linked PR below).
workaround: Manually set invoice.legal_entity to LEG_GLOBAL for affected invoices in AP UI and trigger a subset payment run (ap_payment_runner_03 --invoices=<list>). Finance Ops executed manual override for 14 of 19 invoices to meet earliest vendor cutoff.
next_steps: 1) Data team to revert the precedence change in entity_map_v3 OR add explicit vendor-level override check (target: hotfix release 2026-03-12).
2) Run a reconciliation job to identify all invoices mapped to LEG_EU_02 by entity_map_v3 but with vendor override pointing to LEG_GLOBAL; create corrective patch.
3) Payments team to re-run AP payment job for the remaining invoices after mapping fix is deployed and bank accounts validated.
4) Postmortem and a short-term alert (dashboard) to detect future legal_entity -> bank_account mismatches before payment runs.
resolution: Pending - hotfix PR merged to finance-data (PR 412) and scheduled for deploy 2026-03-12 04:00 UTC. Manual overrides applied to most urgent vendors; final payment run pending post-deploy validation.
